global: A bowl of shoyu ramen features a rich, dark broth with tender noodles and scattered green onions. The blue-and-white patterned bowl holds the steaming meal, set against a dark surface under soft, warm lighting.

regions.background: Dark, smooth, slightly reflective surface with subtle grain, oval shape, and faint edge shadows.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue triangular patterned rim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is dark brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and garnished with green onions.
regions.chopsticks: Light wooden chopsticks, smooth and slightly tapered, rest diagonally with subtle grain patterns visible.
